note: On Two Jack Lake near Lake Minnewanka, about 13 km north-east of Banff. Of the 74 sites, 22 are walk-in tent sites on the shore (14-35) and 10 hold oTENTiks; drive-in sites 1-13 line the access road beside the lake's outlet channel and 36-74 loop through thin trees at the north end, the lake side of that loop nearest the water. No dump station is listed here. --Claude
summary: Keep. 2026 season May 21 - Oct 5 (stored May 20 - Oct 7 was approximate), 74 sites to 27 ft at C$34 plus fire permit, showers and flush toilets added. Lakeview stands; lakefront is an upgrade lead only. PIN is at the entrance: small move proposed.
